items.title: Anthropic IPO raises record $81.3 billion on strong AI demand
items.excerpt: The five-year-old artificial intelligence powerhouse priced its initial public offering at $83 a share, shrugging off growing concern about a possible AI bubble and volatility in tech stocks.

items.title: The law releasing the Epstein files passed one year ago. What do his victims say?
items.excerpt: It's been a year since the House passed the Epstein Files Transparency Act, forcing the Justice Department to release millions of files connected to the convicted sex offender. His victims speak out.

items.title: Why the Nvidia scandal is a national security issue
items.excerpt: The Nvidia scandal has spilled over into the Trump administration, which is now under intense scrutiny for how it allowed America's top AI chips to end up in China's hands.

items.title: Democrats nominate Jeffries for speaker, prep investigations into Trump's orbit
items.excerpt: Democrats gave the official nod to Hakeem Jeffries to be the next speaker of the House. Meanwhile, Democrats are ramping up their plans to investigate the Trump administration come January.

items.title: After Nepal's epic flood, they're restoring their community ... and their lives
items.excerpt: As the emergency response to the flood ends, aid workers turn to the hard work of rebuilding communities that lost everything. Many of those workers lost everything, too.

items.title: Democratic Black women take over almost all state agencies in Georgia soon
items.excerpt: In January, most of Georgia's state agencies will be headed by Black women who were all elected in the 2026 midterms.

items.title: As overdose deaths fall, White House makes misleading claims about who deserves credit
items.excerpt: In a statement celebrating the historic drop in drug deaths, the White House pointed to successes since President Trump took office. In fact, the biggest progress happened under the Biden administration.

items.title: Karl Kani dressed hip-hop royalty for decades. Now he's telling his own story
items.excerpt: On NPR's Morning Edition, fashion designer Karl Kani talks about his new memoir, dressing some of hip-hop's biggest stars and why skinny jeans aren't for everyone.

items.title: Got a canceled flight? 7 clever ways to get rebooked fast
items.excerpt: Flying somewhere for Thanksgiving or the holidays? Travel insiders explain what to do if your flight gets canceled or delayed — so you can quickly get to your destination.

items.title: Democrats formally nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker of the House
items.excerpt: The New York Democrat moved a step closer to becoming the first Black lawmaker in U.S. history to serve in the job, after House Democrats voted overwhelmingly to support him.
